//: A bug hunt finds the batch a range drops, proves it with an input, and changes nothing.
title: The dropped last batch is found and shown, and nothing changes

files.batches.py:
def batches(items, size):
    return [items[start:start + size] for start in range(0, len(items) - size + 1, size)]

proof:
cat <<'EVAL_EOF'
Bug, batches.py:2: batches([1, 2, 3], 2) returns [[1, 2]] and drops the last, partial batch [3]; the range stops too early. Use range(0, len(items), size).
EVAL_EOF
